actorName.description: Null when the actor is not a person of this tenant

kind.description: The action as the console names it

team.description: The team's name; null for an entry outside any team, such as a sign-in

AuditEventIn.description:
One audit entry another service recorded in its outbox (ops_store.audit), as its relay delivers it. The tenant
and team are the service token's.
AuditEventIn.title: AuditEventIn

viewCounts.description: Entries in each of the audit page's views: all, changes (all but sign-ins), access, deletions, publishes, sign_ins
viewCounts.title: Viewcounts

DomainCheckOut.description: A listed domain: routes sign-in only once `verified_at` is set, after `record` was seen in its DNS.

FlagOut.description: One feature flag of the install: on only when the install config names it in OPS_FLAGS.
FlagOut.title: FlagOut

GroupSettings.description:
Identity provider groups to team memberships: `source` is the OIDC claim or SAML attribute that lists
the person's groups (default `groups`).

existingAccount.description: The email already has an account: accept while signed in as it
existingAccount.title: Existingaccount

invitedBy.description: Who sent it; null when that person is gone
invitedBy.title: Invitedby

JitSettings.description:
Where a person new to the workspace lands on their first sign-in through this provider: the team, or with no
team the workspace's default team.
JitSettings.title: JitSettings

Jwk.description: A public key as RFC 7517 names its fields, so they stay snake-free and unaliased.
Jwk.title: Jwk

KeyTarget.description: What an API key may start. `version` pins a workflow version; null runs the live one.
KeyTarget.title: KeyTarget

MetadataIn.description: An identity provider's metadata to read: its URL, or the file's contents.
MetadataIn.title: MetadataIn

Option.description:
One choice in a picker: what it stores, what it shows, a short hint, and why it cannot be chosen when it
cannot (the agent lacks a tool the widget needs, say).
Option.title: Option

OptionsPage.description:
A page of a picker's choices, searched and limited in the store query. `next_cursor` asks for the next page;
None at the end. Every `/options` route answers this, and `ids=` resolves stored values to their labels.
OptionsPage.title: OptionsPage

SsoStartIn.description: Either the person's work email, or a provider's address id (`/sso?provider=`, from an app-portal tile).
SsoStartIn.title: SsoStartIn

TeamDeleteCheckOut.description: Whether a team may be deleted now and why not: the Delete card reads it in one call.
TeamDeleteCheckOut.title: TeamDeleteCheckOut

TransferIn.description: The account admin who becomes the workspace's owner.
TransferIn.title: TransferIn

WorkspaceCloseIn.description: The workspace's name, typed by its owner to confirm the delete.
WorkspaceCloseIn.title: WorkspaceCloseIn

WorkspaceRenameIn.description: The workspace's display name: the bank's or organisation's name people see in the console.
WorkspaceRenameIn.title: WorkspaceRenameIn

WorkspaceStateOut.description: The workspace's owner and status: `purgeAfter` is when a closed workspace's records go, else null.
WorkspaceStateOut.title: WorkspaceStateOut

WorkspaceTeamOut.description: A team as a workspace admin sees it: counts joined by the service.
WorkspaceTeamOut.title: WorkspaceTeamOut

services run with the workspace's policies: allowed with the granting roles, or refused with the reason. The
caller needs access.view there; each check is audited as access.check.

memory sweep). 400 `policy_value` for a key the catalogue does not hold.

settings.manage in the acting team. 400 `policy_value` for a key or value the catalogue does not take.

may not hold: secrets, egress and Security-team ones (400 `not_for_custom_roles` when given; named in
`leftOut` when copied). A workspace admin's (access.manage); audited; 409 `name_taken`.

Deletes a custom role. While anyone holds it, 409 `role_in_use` names them, unless `moveTo` names the role
their assignments move to. A built-in role is not deleted (409 `builtin_role`). Audited.

whether the caller may change it (`canEdit`: a workspace admin, for any role but Admin).

`admin_holds_every_cell` for Admin, 400 `unknown_cell` for a cell outside the catalogue.
